notes.title: The deck data error was fixed
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/826b8bae7b5a7aaf937f1dfde54af16482424b4d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Earlier today, a hotfix intended to fix a flaw in Ranked Mode unexpectedly introduced a serious error. For a short time, players who entered Ranked Mode found that their saved deck lists had been wiped.[/p][p]While the issue was resolved quickly, we regret to say that, after investigating this matter, we are unable to restore decks to their previous state. Rest assured, your collections remain fully intact.[/p][p]As an apology, we’ve delivered a compensation package to all affected players. The next time they log in, they will see 1,000 gold was added to their accounts. If you were affected and have not received compensation, please try to log in once more before contacting support.[/p][p]We know how frustrating it is to lose a deck you’ve carefully crafted, and we’re already taking steps to ensure this never happens again. In the meantime, we encourage the community to rally together — if you have a favourite deck, share it in the in-game chat to help fellow commanders get back into the fight.[/p][p]Thank you for your patience, your passion, and your understanding.[/p]

It is now or never."[/i] [/p][p]– Lhykhis  [/p][p][/p][p]A new strand is woven into the skein of fate. Lhykhis the Whispering Web, peerless Phoenix Lord of the Warp Spider temple, jumps upon the battlefield at the command of her silent hunters. Elusive, unpredictable, and devastating, the [b]Warp Spiders[/b] emerge from the Webway into [b]Warhammer 40,000: Warpforge[/b] in a haunting new [b]Reinforcement Drop and Raid Event[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]The new Whispering Web Reinforcement Drop brings up to ten new cards for the Saim-Hann Craftworld, first collectable through an awesome Raid Event! At the front of the new cards, Lhykhis, a new Warlord, will become available, ready to protect the craftworlds of the Aeldari. The Whispering Web raid event will last from July 17th until July 27th at 9 AM UTC. Keep reading to find out all about what’s coming![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/251273da03a5fa4faf180824757b0bf74214c6bc.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]New Content: Lhykhis[/b][/h2][p]Lhykhis joins the game as a new [b]Saim-Hann Warlord[/b], and she does not come alone. As the Phoenix Lord of the [b]Warp Spider[/b], Lhykhis commands a force of warriors who appear and vanish in a blink—masters of teleportation and stealth tactics. She was gone for so long that even many in her temple considered her a myth, but now she’s ready to brave the Webway and strike against the foes of the Craftworld![/p][p]In this [b]Reinforcement Drop and Raid Event[/b], Lhykhis brings [b]up to 10 new Saim-Hann cards[/b], including deadly [b]Warp Spider warriors[/b] and haunting stratagems from the depths of the Webway. New [b]cosmetic items[/b] will also be available to theme your decks in the image of the Whispering Web. Check out the card reveal videos by [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7ojeWijLPN4"]Aquaman[/url] and [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n9TRETmJdq0"]The Ecclesiarch[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/2d1a04a13ce9e4d2a3a53468c3e42bab44e99227.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Unlock new collectable content in a new Raid[/b][/h2][p]Before the new content becomes fully available through booster packs and wildcards, it will be released exclusively through the Whispering Web Raid event, [b]lasting from July 17th until July 27th at 9 am UTC[/b].[/p][p]During this Raid event, the whole player base will join forces to unlock new content by earning Medals, an in-game currency that can be spent to collect the new cards in the Raid menu, available only during the event.[/p][p]Taking part in the Raid Event will allow players to:[/p][list][*][p]Get access to some of the new content for free, just for playing the game. [b]Raid event rewards are in addition to all normal rewards[/b] from playing, and [b]any remaining Medals will get converted into Crystals[/b] at the end of the event.[/p][/*][*][p]Try out the Saim-Hann faction in case they haven’t already done so. A new daily Raid Challenge will reward playing a few matches each day as the Saim-Hann in multiplayer mode (both Ranked and Unranked). Remember that you can get enough cards to build Saim-Hann decks by completing the first few levels of their Campaign.[/p][/*][*][p]Rally all players around a common objective to unlock some amazing cards and cosmetics into the game.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]How to earn medals in the Raid[/b][/h2][p]You take part in the raid simply by playing the game! The main focus of a Raid Event is earning Medals to both unlock and collect new content. You can earn Medals in several ways:[/p][list][*][p]At the end of Multiplayer matches (both Ranked and Unranked), in varying quantities depending on the number of Skulls earned in the match.[/p][/*][*][p]As a reward for completing a special daily Raid mission. Earn Skulls in Multiplayer matches (Ranked & Unranked) with an Saim-Hann deck to fulfil it![/p][/*][*][p]Purchased with Gold and through special bundles available during the raid event.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/c87e816be8c73083ce6761168790bf0a58e9a325.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]How does new content get unlocked?[/b][/h2][p]Not all of the new content will be available from the beginning, and you will need to work together with your fellow players to unlock it all into the game! [b]All Medals acquired by players are also added to a global tally[/b]. Once this tally reaches certain milestones, a new card or cosmetic will join the game and become available for purchase with Medals during the event.[/p][p]Your individual progress in the Raid is also tracked. Consistently earning Medals and helping the global tally grow will not only help unlock new content but also net you enough Medals to collect it. [b]If your individual Medal progress reaches specific milestones[/b] and the reward has been unlocked, you will be able to buy that reward with a [b]massive discount[/b]! Playing the game is the best way to get your hands on the new content.[/p][p][b]Spending your Medals WILL NOT reduce your individual nor the collective Raid progress[/b]. All Medals earned during the event are included in the tally, not just your current balance.[/p][h2][b]
How else can I collect the new content?[/b][/h2][p]The Raid menu also features two special shops where you can spend the Medals you have obtained. These two shops include [b]Lhykhis[/b] and 7 of the new cards, which are immediately unlocked from the start, as well as new themed cosmetic items to give your new Saim-Hann decks a look worthy of the Whispering Web.[/p][p]Spending your medals does not reduce your raid progress, so shop away and collect the new reinforcements for the Saim-Hann! Both the Cards and Cosmetics Raid shops are static and will not change during the event, so you will always know what’s in store. They will also remain available for roughly one day after the event finishes, to allow you to spend any remaining Medals before they get converted into Crystals.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/8f9b4f4aab945e478fd62d81c1ff4a7a463262cb.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Become a Premium Raider[/b][/h2][p]For those who want to make the most out of the Raid, there will be a “Premium Raid Bundle” purchase available during the event. When you get this bundle, you will receive 1,500 Medals to spend in the raid’s special shop – enough, for example, to add Lhykhis to your collection right at the start of the Raid event! These Medals will also be added to the global tally, so you will be helping all players push it towards its next milestone![/p][p]Besides those Medals, you will get the ‘Premium Raider’ badge status, a passive account effect which increases the Medals you receive from daily Raid Mission by a whopping 150% for the duration of the Raid. With this bonus, you will not only collect everything faster but also push the global tally further and further to the next milestone.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/3d29828a72ce0b0bfe0202c1031319a35d04371e.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]What happens when the Raid ends?[/b][/h2][p]Once the Raid ends on [b]July 27th[/b], there will be a 1-day Grace Period during which the Raid menu will still be available, but no more Medals will be earned. This will be your last chance to collect your unclaimed raid rewards and spend your Medals in the Raid’s Card and Cosmetic shops.[/p][p]At the end of this period, all your remaining Medals will be converted into Crystals, and the Raid menu will disappear.[/p][h2][b]When will the new cards appear in Booster Packs?[/b][/h2][p]Shortly after the Raid ends, the new Saim-Hann Craftworld cards will become available in Booster Packs, and players will be able to craft them with Wildcards. [b]An inbox message will announce exactly when this happens[/b]. After the new cards are available in booster packs, we will top the raid off and celebrate with a new Promo Code rewarding a few booster packs! If there are any cards that are not unlocked in the Raid, they will not become collectable – they won’t appear in booster packs and will be removed from the Collection.[/p][p]Gear up and prepare for your next battle! Get ready to weave the fate of the Aeldari in a new Raid Event. It is time to muster the craftworld and vanquish its foes for the kin’s survival.[/p]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/8dd0c6c19ce9b51e67ef6abea19586cb5a192516.jpg[/img]
Did you see the new [b]Auto-zoom[/b] feature? Introduced in the latest update, Auto-zoom increases battlefield legibility by adapting the camera zoom to the number of units in the game. This new feature is automatically enabled on small-screen devices, where it's most useful, but it can also be enabled on the Desktop version from the Graphics section of Settings menu.

Update v1.27.2 also introduced [b]camera controls[/b] inside the game. Zoom in and out using touchscreen controls or the mouse wheel and be free to explore the battlefield with your right click! A button in the left side of the screen will let you return the camera to its default position. 

Check out all the new features introduced in the latest version of the game in the latest [url=https://www.warpforge40k.com/warhammer-40000-warpforge-v1-27-2-notes/]web post[/url].

Claim a Card Back just for playing during Early Access! We are nearing the full release of Warhammer 40,000: Warpforge! The release celebration will begin on October 3rd, but before that, we wanted to celebrate the players who helped bring Warpforge to life during the Early Access stage of the game. As a token of our appreciation, head over to the [url=https://shop.warpforge40k.com/]Webshop[/url] and claim a free card back.

To use the [url=https://shop.warpforge40k.com/]Webshop[/url], make sure your in-game account is registered with your email and password. Log into the [url=https://shop.warpforge40k.com/]Webshop[/url] with that same email and password and claim your reward! It will be delivered to you via an inbox message and you will be able to claim it when the game releases on October 3rd.

After less than a year the game is so much larger than when it first released on Early Access, growing non-stop with a constant stream of new content and exciting feature updates. Our ambitions have not changed though, and there are still so many corners of the Galaxy left to explore!

notes.title: Faction leaderboards are now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/ffe757c894a53c42b82c1ea63bc5275356f8c834.jpg[/img]

The Galaxy burns fiercer than ever! Commanders are already showing their strategic mastery in the new ranking system and fighting for the top ranks. We have now released an update that brings a number of important fixes into the game: 
[list]
[*] Enable the leaderboards for each individual faction! Can you top the ranking for your favourite faction?
[*] Global and faction leaderboards now use the highest rating obtained this season with each faction. Your current faction rating is still used for matchmaking and will appear in the battle log records, but for Legendary players, the rating displayed in leaderboards, profile and in the alliance menu can only go up now, not down (within a season)
[*] Fixed Honours displayed so that they start at 1 on every rank, instead of starting at zero. This is just a visual change, the actual progression of players hasn’t changed, nor the Honours required to progress through each rank.
[*] Fixed the rating displayed in the Battle Log, so that it reflects your and your opponent’s faction ratings (which are used to calculate the rating variations) rather than the Global Rating. This only applies to matches played after installing this update, though, previous matches still show the Global Rating, which can make some rating variations look wrong.
[*] Draws in Ranked, in Legendary Division, no longer cause both players to lose ranking.
[*] Losing or drawing an Unranked match will no longer break a win streak in Ranked.
[*] Fixed an error in the Tutorial battles on iOS devices.
[*] Fixed Ephrael Stern, who was always dealing 2 damage on Pray, instead of 2-3.
[*] Remove an sneaky faction icon from the Profile/Ranking tab (in Legendary division).
[/list]
There has never been a better time to fight in the ranked ladder! Hone your deck and conquer the leaderboards!

notes.title: The new Ultramarine cards join the collection!
notes.notes:

[i]“The Emperor's wrath is swift and unrelenting.”[/i]
– Chaplain Letharius

[b]Charge forward![/b] Strike Force Letharius enters the game with its full might today. All of the new cards have been unlocked in the raid event, and Letharius and his ironclad squad will start appearing in shops and Booster Packs from now on. This means they are also now craftable using Wildcards, so start collecting them now!

If you were in the middle of a session, you might need to restart the game before being able to craft the new cards. The change to the booster packs does not require restarting the game.

Get ready to [b]crush the enemies of the Imperium[/b] with utmost speed and zeal!

notes.title: Unleash the Emperor's Judgement with New Medal Offers!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/a922f05e7b2bbf5b6d379d345f04e3fb821475da.jpg[/img]
[i]"No one outruns the Emperor's judgement!"[/i]
– Chaplain Letharius

Customize your profile as a true son of Guilliman and collect the new cards with our new Medal offers! These big bundles will not only boost your personal Raid progress, but also give a big push to unlocking the next milestones. Don't miss this chance to:

[b]● Get an exclusive Devastator Centurion avatar and 1500 Medals[/b], enough to recruit the new Warlord, Chaplain Letharius, into your lines!
[b]● Don the new 'Solemn Judgement' card back in battle and earn 4000 Medals to boost your collection[/b]
[b]● Become a Premium Raider[/b] and get 1500 Medals instantly, plus a badge that increases the Medals you receive from daily Raid Mission by a whopping 150%

This is the best time to collect the new content! Don't miss out on these amazing deals and charge forward to the next milestone.

notes.title: Unlock the new cards in an awesome new Raid event
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/7f2fe5d9993490937007cd08e79aa40cf52ac462.jpg[/img]
[i]"We are His will made manifest!"[/i]
– Chaplain Letharius

Fight during the Raid event and collect new cards before they are available for crafting and in booster packs! Until the 4th of July, you will earn Medals in three ways:
● By playing Multiplayer matches in varying quantities depending on the Skulls you earned
● As a reward for completing a special daily mission. Sharpen your Ultramarines deck to complete it!
● Purchased with Gold and through special bundles available during the raid event.

Medals are not only added to your personal balance, but also to a collective tally that will serve to unlock even more new content into the game after reaching certain milestones! These Medals can be used to purchase the new content before it's added to the game. Spending them will not reduce your global or personal Raid progress, so start collecting new cards from day 1!

[i]"Fight with fire and courage and nothing can stand against us."[/i]
– Commander Shadowsun

The T'au Empire joins the battlefields of Warpforge as an entirely new faction, ready to unleash their superior firepower against the enemies of the T'au'va. Start collecting them now and fight for the Greater Good as an iconic new faction of the Warhammer 40,000 universe.

[h1]Take a look at the new cards[/h1]
Check out the T’au Empire’s full card collection [url=https://www.warpforge40k.com/warpforge-card-list/nggallery/album/tau-empire]here[/url]! Meet the new Warlords, Stratagems and Troops that will spread the light of the T’au’va in the battlefields of Warpforge. Take a peek at the full extent of the T’au Empire’s collection to master their tactics in preparation for tomorrow’s release, and share your ideas in the [i]#deck-building[/i] channel of the [url=https://discord.gg/warpforge]official Discord server[/url].

[previewyoutube=J5jijMt8CQs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]New Warlords[/h1]
Young as their Empire is, many T’au heroes are already counted among their legends, inspiring new generations of leaders and commanders. Among them, three of their most renowned heroes will lead the Empire’s Cadres into battle at the time of release:
[list]
[*][b]Commander O’Maisos[/b]: An exemplar among the Fire Warriors of the Vior’la Sept, this hot-blooded commander hurls herself into battle inside her XV86 Coldstar Battlesuit.
[*][b]Aun’va[/b]: Aun’Va is the oldest and highest-ranking of the Ethereal Council. His voice is law across the entire T’au Empire. His hand is visible in many of his people’s greatest achievements.
[*][b]Shadowsun[/b]: Clad in her highly advanced XV22 Stalker Battlesuit, Commander O’Shaserra employs her strategic genius to orchestrate elaborate plans, destroying the enemy’s most valuable assets.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/09f71eacd29ac88752b2d387f972ef44493f80df.jpg[/img]
[h1]New card mechanics[/h1]
With the introduction of the T’au Empire, three new traits also make their way into Warpforge! Get ready to target and delete your enemies from afar and deploy swarms of drones with:
[list]
[*][b]Long Range[/b]: units with this trait receive no damage when performing a Ranged Attack. They will lose Long Range after receiving an enemy attack, so protect them to get insane value!
[*][b]Markerlight[/b]: When a Marked enemy receives damage from a Ranged Attack, it will receive additional damage equal to its Markerlight value, helping the T’au to perform efficient kills.
[*][b]Companion[/b]: After playing a troop with a Companion, the player will receive an Ephemeral copy of the troop designated by the trait. This troop can be played as many times as the number specified on the card. So, for example, playing a troop with “Companion 2: Gun Drone” will add a Gun Drone to the player’s hand that can be played up to 2 times. Same as with Tide, this card only lasts until the end of the turn, so make use of it while you can!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/d94acb83719813b812db1cfac8b9e2f9b1f8932a.jpg[/img]
[h1]How to start collecting them[/h1]
Take advantage of pre-release and release-day deals to get extra value when collecting the new faction! The T’au Empire joins the game as an entirely new faction, so the new cards will be collectable by similar means to the existing factions.
[list]
[*]T’au Empire Booster Packs, each including 5 T’au Empire cards, with at least one of them of rare or higher quality.
[*]All Armies Booster Packs have a chance at yielding T’au Empire cards while opening them.
[*]Get AMAZING VALUE with the exclusive release bundle, featuring the T’au Empire Premium Campaign, 25 T'au Empire booster packs and three themed cosmetics. Available for a few days only!
[*]Exclusive T’au Empire high-value booster bundles available in the Web Shop.
[*]New Twitch Drops campaign. Watch your favourite content creators play Warpforge and earn amazing rewards while at it. Only until 1st April!
[*]From the 22nd March onward, the new T’au Empire cards will make frequent appearances in the shop. Every day there will be new cards for sale, so keep your eyes peeled!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/cb6efd0cd433e6a6ba53cb66b88c52eebade33bb.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Promo Code[/h1]
Celebrate the new release and begin your fight for the Greater Good with a new promotional code. Input promo code “[b]GREATERGOOD[/b]” in-game after the T’au Empire is released to receive 2 T’au Empire Booster Packs for free, valid only until 4th April. For the Greater Good!

The T'au Empire is ready to showcase the superiority of their drone-assisted Battlesuits and anti-grav vehicles on the battlefield. Are you ready to perform a perfect Mont'ka and lead the fight for the greater good?

notes.title: Update v1.10.0 release notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/5eaa32f4c7e0815deb809cda9a6996c9507d1213.jpg[/img]
The T’au Empire joins the game tomorrow! Update v1.10.0 sets the stage for the arrival of the new faction and introduces many fixes and improvements, particularly on touch devices.

On mobile devices and Steam Deck (if ‘Touch Input’ setting is enabled), players will now be able to enlarge the cards in their hand and read their description by simply moving your finger horizontally across them, rather than having to open them one by one. To change the order of cards in your hand, they just need to drag a card slightly upwards, and then move it to the desired position.

Font sizes have also been reviewed in many places, to make sure they are easy to read on small screens. Make sure the ‘Large font size’ setting is enabled (which should happen by default on touch devices).

One other important change is the Goff offence card ‘Night Attack’, which has been reworked as it was almost never used. Its new description reads: ‘When a troop is deployed, it gets -1 Ranged Attack until its next turn’.

These changes are now live. Get ready to lead the fight for the Greater Good when the T’au Empire is released tomorrow!

notes.title: Release notes v1.7.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/2b65cfc6c0501991a7d2dba84e1c85af8ae2414d.jpg[/img]
[i]"Activating reanimation protocol."[/i]
– Necron Technomancer

Update v1.7.0 is now live on all platforms, introducing a new feature to test your decks, quality of life improvements and a new Promo code. Take a look at the changes introduced in this update:

[h3]New features[/h3]
● New ‘practice’ mode to test your decks against a bot before taking them into multiplayer. From the Decks menu in Collection, just open your deck and use the Practice button next to Edit Deck. These matches also count towards Missions!
● New custom interactions between some warlords at the start of the match. Can you find them all?
● The Cosmetics Shop has been removed from the game. We are working on other ways of obtaining them in the game. Read on to find out how to get a free avatar!

[h3]QoL improvements[/h3]
● The turn timer now starts the countdown when there are 15 seconds left, instead of 10.
● Show cursor again in Steam Deck when the 'Touch Input’ toggle in Settings is disabled

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
● The game performance has been optimised significantly, to reduce battery use and to improve the frame rate in low-spec devices.
● Improve mobile interface in battle, so that the stats of cards in hand are visible.
● Improved error handling to manage some edge cases which could leave the game on a black screen instead of showing the main menu after loading.
● Makari has been fixed, as it was not always applying his buff after being killed by Shuriken.

[h3]Avatar gift[/h3]
We are giving away an amazing Avatar cosmetic to all players: the Remnant! It is a token of gratitude for your patience while we fixed the various issues on mobile, particularly the game-breaking visual problem with Remnants, and for having to update the game several times.

To get this avatar, redeem the code ‘[b]REMNANT[/b]’ in-game or on the [url=https://account.warpforge40k.com/]new website[/url] before the end of November to gain this unique cosmetic item.

As stated above, these are the changes in the latest of a long list of updates that have gone live during this week. Get a full recap of what has changed in the new [url=https://www.warpforge40k.com/v1-7-0-release-notes/]web post[/url].

notes.title: Release notes v1.5.5
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/93f20c8ed571fc4ff42f193aaf9e2023b914009e.jpg[/img]

[i]"The Emperor's work must be safeguarded"[/i]

Update v1.5.5 brings important usability improvements primarily for mobile devices:
[list]
[*] An overhaul of text and element sizes across the game should improve the readability on phone screens, which has been an overwhelming piece of feedback we have received.
[*] This update introduces three quality configurations, which should expand the range of supported devices. Android devices default to 'Medium' quality, but for those that were running the game without problems, we recommend switching to 'High' quality (in Settings -> Graphics) for the best visual experience.
[*] This version should also fix the difficulties tapping to see units in battle and clicking on some buttons and elements of the interface.
[*] Additionally, Burna Boy's damage has been fixed, as it was always dealing 2 damage before.
[/list]

We are aware of some compatibility issues remaining on Android, particularly a serious error triggered by the Necrons’ Remnant trait. We are working hard to resolve it as soon as possible, as well as some other problems that have come up on the mobile version. You can expect further improvements and bug fixes in the next few days.

Thank you for your patience and support!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/e0e36fe14587a7341f4978bde8e22e755fcd30d1.jpg[/img]

[i]"We will conquer this galaxy!"[/i]
– Sylar Hexscorn

Muster the Chapter, ready your endless legions and call the Hive Mind, for the hour of clashing blades is upon us! Here are some quick notes about what to expect from the mobile release: 

[b]When does update go live on mobile?[/b]
Those who pre-ordered on the App Store already have the game available, since midnight in their respective time zone. On Google Play, the game will become available at 2pm GMT.

[b]I already have an account on Steam. How can I log in on mobile?[/b]
Within the game, you need to register your account with an email and password. To do so, head to the in-game Settings menu's "Account" tab. You can then use those details to log in from any device and platform.

[b]I purchased a pre-sale bundle. How can I redeem it?[/b]
On Android and PC, just open the Settings panel and click on ‘Redeem code’.
On iOS, please contact support through Settings -> Support -> Support and clicking the text bubble / ‘Contact Us’ button, letting us know your code, and we will redeem it for you as soon as possible.

[b]When will I receive the 10 booster packs for pre-registering on Google Play or pre-ordering on the App Store?[/b]
This reward will become available at 2pm GMT, when the Google Play version is released. Please remember that this promotion is available even if you are logging into an existing account created on Steam, and that it can only be redeemed once per account.

[b]I can’t play a friendly duel against a friend on mobile/Steam[/b]
Update v1.4.5 will become available shortly on all platforms. Once all players are on the same game version, they will be able to find each other in matchmaking and friendly duels regardless of which platform they are playing on. Before then, iOS devices are using a more recent version of the game than Steam, so players on different platforms will not be matched in battle.

notes.title: How to get the starter decks for all factions
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/11be3fd307591188afad54ca071df2471625a7b8.png[/img]
[i]Each path must be chosen with care.[/i]
– Varro Tigurius

In Warpforge, you can collect a starter deck for each of the available factions. Why choose one when you can play with all of them?

To do so, head to the campaign menu and select the faction you prefer. You can change your selected faction at any time. Your campaign advances when you collect the rewards from the Missions menu. Fulfill a mission to complete the campaign's first node, and you will receive that faction's Starter Deck as a reward!

You can repeat this process with any of the available factions to get their starter decks, so get ready to command all of your favourite factions into battle!

notes.title: Release notes for hotfix v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hotfix v1.0.1 has just gone live, with a couple of important fixes:
● The login/name selection popup clearly indicates now when you have already successfully logged into an existing account.
● Card texts in Polish should now be in... Polish.
● The onboarding tips have been tweaked to convey more clearly that: 
 1) you can choose any starting faction you want, not necessarily Orks,
 2) you can change your preferred faction at any time, by clicking on that faction icon in the Campaigns menu. 

Campaign Points gained from Missions go towards the faction that's selected when you claim the Mission reward. You can change from faction to faction at any time, for example to collect all the starter decks before focusing on your preferred faction.

A further update will follow up shortly with several more fixes, including an issue when collecting premium campaign rewards which can cause a server error (the reward isn't lost when the error happens, though; it can still be collected after restarting the game).

One further error we have detected is that, during the first few hours, a couple of the cards granted in the Ultramarines starter deck were incorrect. Instead of including Lieutenant Calsius and Octavio Infiltrator, everyone who collected the deck during that time received two epic cards, Company Ancient and Primaris Impulsor. Affected players may need to replace one or two cards in the deck if they appear as unavailable.

Thank you for your help reporting these errors, and for your patience while we iron them out!

notes.title: Which factions triumphed during last demo?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/e6fa959921e530fa4966f2a8f6cecab7ed089d99.jpg[/img]
[i]"You proved yourself to be a worthy foe." [/i]
– Imotekh the Stormlord 

The Galaxy did not stand idle against The Great Devourer! The many warring factions armed up during Warhammer Skulls and prepared to prevent the Tyranid swarm from overwhelming them. Let's take a look at the data from the last demo. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/d9b91e8a8def63bcee67e1005fdc2a241cdcfee3.jpg[/img]

Between draft and multiplayer matches, the Saim-Hann Aeldari stand as the more successful army on the battlefield, averaging a 55,82% win rate besides being the least used in matches, with a 12,3% use rate. Some of their decks and strategies stood out as particularly dominant and may require some reviewing. The Sautekh Dynasty Necrons also showed their mastery of warfare, achieving a fantastic 54% win rate, very closely followed by the Black Legion who earned their dark glory in 53,38% of their battles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/9e71a69db96339e08cb0b569a9542bcc20f37e18.jpg[/img]

A bit below the rest of the factions in terms of win rate, the heroes of the Ultramarines were successful in 50,69% of their missions, while the Hive Fleet Leviathan devoured 50,35% of the battlefields they fought on. Unsurprisingly, the newly introduced Hive Fleet Leviathan was also the most popular faction, appearing in 23,3% of the played matches. The mighty Orks from the Goff Clan scrapped a respectable 46,69% of victories in their matches, but the greenest and meanest warbosses are surely planning how to do better in their next krumpin'.

The introduction of a quick and aggressive faction like the Saim-Hann during the previous demo made the first-player advantage more noticeable, but the new Defensive Stratagem system has had a clear effect in reducing this advantage. Now that the second player receives a special one-use stratagem, the first-player win rate has gone down to 55% from the previous demo's 63%, a welcome sight but still something we will focus on before the game's release. 

Taking a look at specific characters, Abaddon the Despoiler has been the clear player favourite, slaying his enemies with every swing of Drach'nyen in 10,63% of the matches. Not even the novelty of Hive Fleet Leviathan could take that away from the Warmaster, but the Swarmlord and the Neurothrope were still the second and third most popular Warlords in this last demo, achieving an 8,56% and 7,61% of use rate respectively. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/3388db4350f64d950781eeeb391bc74d4cd9e2a2.jpg[/img]

As for character win rate, Eliac Zephyrblade has menaced the Galaxy with a staggering 68,2% win rate. The next most successful Warlords were the Swarmlord and Abaddon, with 59,1% and 58,8% of wins respectively. The most dominant strategies from these factions will be on our radar and reviewed before moving on to the game's release. The same goes for strategies and characters that didn't quite hit the mark, such as the Tervigon who unfortunately sported the lowest win rate of the event, with only 36% of success. Of course, pre-built deck and draft formats are not fully representative of the final game, which will feature full deck building and customisation, but by combining these statistics with internal data points we intend to make appropriate changes to give you the best experience on release. 

Thank you so much for taking part in the Warhammer Skulls demo. The game's closed alpha will be revealed soon, so stay tuned for more! notes.title: Preliminary Demo Stats are out!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/b13c89b71dc22fd8ffedc939031cf6a755205541.png[/img]
"You proved yourself to be a worthy foe."
– Imotekh the Stormlord

After a few days of intense clashes in the far future, we have some preliminary data for the second public demo of Warhammer 40.000: Warpforge, which we thought to share with you.

Between practice and multiplayer matches, the newly added Sautekh Dynasty have been more succesful at conquering the battlefield, averaging a 53.1% winrate across the board. They should not get too complacent though, both of the other available factions are following their steps very closely. the heroes of the Ultramarines were succesful in 50.6% of their missions, while the mighty Orks from the Goff Clan scrapped a nice 47.9% of victories in their matches. So far the turn order has made an impact, with 56.5% of players who go first winning their matches, but it's a lower percentage than during the previous demo. This is still one of the key points we aim to adjust in the future.

Unsurprisingly, during the start of the demo, the new Sautekh Dynasty has been the most popular factions among players, with a 50% use rate. Following the trend of the previous demo, the Ultramarines are still ahead of the Goff Orks in terms of popularity, with the great warriors of the Imperium achieving a 26% use rate, compared to the cunning Orks' 24%.

Taking a look at specific characters, Nemesor Zandrekh reigns supreme with a mighty 57.7% winrate, and his 18.2% use rate comes only second to Imotekh the Stormlord, who has become the most popular Warlord of the demo so far with a 20.8% of usage. Marneus Calgar and the mighty Ghazghkull Thrakka still hold their ground with a very good 53.4% and 51.9% win rates respectively. Grukk Face-Rippa has unfortunately become the Warlord that sees the least amount of success on the battlefield, with a below average 45.1% winrate.

Using this in combination with other data points, we will be able to adjust the power level of both of our factions and the ones that will be introduced moving forward.

The demo is still available on Steam! Make sure to test your mettle against other great commanders while you have the chance.

notes.title: First Demo Ending and Statistics
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/e7fa4e9d732a34f02d804695cdef7c742318b523.jpg[/img]
[i]"We'll be backs for more!"[/i]
– Boss Zagstruk

After more than two weeks of intense clashes in the far future, the first public demo of Warhammer 40.000: Warpforge has ended. Thank you very much for taking part in this first showing of the game. We hope you enjoyed your battles in the grim darkness!

Another thank you to those that took the time to share their feedback both on social media and using the in-game feedback form. We have been able to gather lots of useful comments and suggestions and will make use of them to improve and balance the game and make it feel better.

We will also make other adjustments based on the data we gathered during the demo, and wanted to share a few curious tidbits with all of you.

Between practice and multiplayer matches, the Goff Orks were the most favoured faction, averaging a 54.5% winrate across the board. The Ultramarines were still able to hold their feet, with a 48.5% winrate. The turn order made a sizable impact. Players who went first had an average winrate of 59%. This is one of the key points that we will adjust before the next public demo.

Interestingly, the Ultramarines were the most popular faction. Players chose to embody the heroes of the Ultramarines in 55% of the matches, while the cunning brutality of the Goff warbosses was only let loose in 45% of them.

If we look at particular characters we see a similar trend. Boss Zagstruk became the most successful Warlord during the demo, achieving a 57% winrate, yet he was the least popular character with only 9% of played matches. On the other hand, Uriel Ventris was the worst performing Warlord of the demo with only a 44% winrate, but he was also the second most popular warlord, after Varro Tigurius (with 20% and 22% use rate respectively)

Using this in combination with other data points, we will be able to adjust the power level of both of these factions and the ones that will be introduced moving forward. 

Even the toughest heroes need some respite between battles. We hope to see you take command of the greatest warriors of the Warhammer 40,000 universe in the next Warpforge demo! Stay tuned for more details!

The Horus Heresy: Legions is available on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1031140/The_Horus_Heresy_Legions/]Steam[/url] for PC and MAC, and on mobile devices via the [url=https://apps.apple.com/app/id1398384203]App Store[/url] and [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Everguild.HorusHeresy]Google Play[/url].

notes.title: Earn exclusive rewards by playing 40K card game Warpforge in alpha
notes.notes: During the annual Warhammer Skulls for the Skull Throne event earlier this year, when Warhammer 40,000 CRPG Rogue Trader and retro FPS Boltgun were announced, we also heard word of a digital card game called Warpforge. notes.title: The next 40K videogame is a free-to-play card game
notes.notes: Not content with the Warhammer x Magic: The Gathering crossover due in August, the grim far future setting of Warhammer 40,000 is coming to a new collectible card game of its own called Warpforge. Just announced as part of the annual Warhammer event Skulls for the Skull Throne, Warpforge will be a free-to-play card game based on "brutal and fast-paced skirmishes.".. Read more.
